cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): the fundamental principle or process underlying the universe, often ineffable and beyond human comprehension
cards.Nuance (English): implied to be non-dual, unchanging, and the origin of all phenomena
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken is not the eternal Way, the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；
